vulnerability_title: [M-18] Pair pre-creation disables Launchpad rewards hooks leading to no fees accrued or distributed

recommendation.recommendation_text:
Restrict `createPair` for Launchpad markets to Launchpad only or always pass real `launchpadLp` and `launchpadFeeDistributor` to `initialize(...)` regardless of caller.

[View detailed Proof of Concept](https://code4rena.com/audits/2025-08-gte-perps-and-launchpad/submissions/F-11)
